questions.question: Analyse how the poet uses structure and language to convey the theme of loss in 'When You Are Old' by Yeats

points.text: Three stanzas move from present to past to future. Iambic pentameter creates reflective tone. 'Glad grace' (alliteration) contrasts with 'pilgrim soul' (metaphor). Final stanza 'bending down beside the glowing bars' -- imagery of ageing/regret. ABBA rhyme encloses memory
